lesson.grammar_point: present simple of action verbs in the affirmative and negative, with the -s of he and she and with don't and doesn't

listenings.text: Hi, I am Ashley. Let me tell you about my day. I wake up at six thirty in the morning. I have breakfast with my mother. She makes eggs every morning. My brother doesn't have breakfast. He only drinks water. School starts at eight and it finishes at three. After school I go to basketball practice. I practice three days a week. On the weekend I don't practice. I sleep, I watch television and I play video games with my friends. I am always tired on Monday.

Good morning, group two. Here is the plan for the week. We start at nine every day. On Monday and Wednesday we practice shooting. On Tuesday and Thursday we play games. On Friday we watch videos and we talk about the games. The camp doesn't open on the weekend, so you have Saturday and Sunday free. And please bring your notes from the video class. See you at nine.

extra_audio.text: Bruno wakes up at five thirty in the morning. He goes to school at seven. He finishes school in the afternoon. He does his homework at home. He plays basketball with his friends.
